{{Top|leg}}
A '''micrel power supply''' was a miniature power source used with small devices. Micrel supplies created little heat, thus they could be used with [[Cybernetics/Legends|artificial]] [[Limb/Legends|limbs]] and other devices that came into direct contact with flesh.
